text: Anja Hohenester-Zimmern being rude is an option yes. I have come here as an tourist being legally married to an israeli spouse for 7 years almost , never applied for the visa until october of last year which we decided to stay here while I was on tourist visa , they are extending my family reunification application by giving me all the time till this day an Tourist Visa so I can stay in Israel until I complete all my documents in Herzliya Pituach Branch . They have asked me to send them directly in the Email so I wont be dealing all the time with the delays of the application. So yes I came as an tourist but decided to stay for good , I know personally how this is going for me and if it helps her too she can have the option to do so ! Thank you ☺️
